emergence.summary: A single-gene CTNS loss-of-function removes cystinosin, the proton-driven lysosomal-membrane transporter that EXPORTS cystine out of the lysosome to the cytosol. Cystinosin is the BRAKE on intra-lysosomal cystine accumulation; with CTNS LOF the brake is released, free cystine accumulates inside lysosomes, crystallises, and damages cells (renal proximal-tubule Fanconi first, then a multi-organ course) -> the intra-lysosomal cystine burden is driven UP. Read as a released BRAKE on toxic accumulation (cystinosin clears lysosomal cystine; LOF releases the clearance -> cystine UP) -- the released-brake -> over-accumulation convention (tyrosinaemia / porphyria / OTC / FCS / haemochromatosis) carried onto a lysosomal-storage axis, but with a DISTINCT lysosomal-storage MECHANISM and lever class. Unlike the four enzyme-deficiency lysosomal-storage reads (Gaucher / Fabry / Pompe / -- where catabolic throughput is restored by REPLACING the enzyme), here the defect is TRANSPORT, not catabolism, so the kit re-derives a SMALL-MOLECULE SUBSTRATE-DEPLETER as the lead lever: cysteamine enters the lysosome and reacts with the stored cystine to form cysteine plus a cysteine-cysteamine mixed disulfide, both of which exit through transporters left intact by the CTNS lesion -- the stored substrate is depleted in situ WITHOUT restoring cystinosin (an upstream/in-situ RESTRAINT on the burden, NOT enzyme replacement). The FIFTH lysosomal-storage read and the FIRST whose lead lever is a small-molecule substrate-depleter rather than enzyme replacement -- a new lysosomal lever class. The switch-level lever RESTORES cystinosin (autologous haematopoietic-stem-cell CTNS gene therapy, investigational; net axis effect lowers the burden -> restrain-coded, the OTC/haemochromatosis convention). The gamma read is of the CTNS locus switch STRUCTURE (a GC-rich promoter, one of the higher gamma in the kit); the disease lesion is coding/structural (the common 57-kb founder deletion; truncating/missense alleles), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: intra-lysosomal free-cystine burden (lysosomal cystine accumulation / crystallisation) -- a transport-defect lysosomal-storage axis, distinct from the enzyme-deficiency storage reads

per_gene.note: CTNS encodes cystinosin, the H+-driven lysosomal cystine EXPORTER that moves free cystine out of the lysosome. As the BRAKE on intra-lysosomal cystine accumulation, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> cystine accumulates inside lysosomes and crystallises (toxic storage). The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding/deletion lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the LYSOSOMAL CYSTINE BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it. 17p13.2 (OMIM 606272). NCBI official symbol CTNS. Autosomal recessive. Coding/structural lesions (the 57-kb founder deletion; truncating/missense alleles).
per_gene.src: Town 1998 Nat Genet 18:319 (CTNS identified; 57-kb deletion); Kalatzis 2001 EMBO J 20:5940 (cystinosin is the lysosomal cystine transporter)

levers.push_direction: deplete the stored lysosomal cystine in situ -- cysteamine reacts with cystine to form cysteine + a cysteine-cysteamine mixed disulfide that exit via intact transporters -> lower the intra-lysosomal cystine burden (bypasses the cystinosin defect); the established lead

levers.push_direction: restore cystinosin so lysosomal cystine is exported again -> lower the stored burden (definitive, switch-level); net axis effect LOWERS the burden

falsifiers.claim: CTNS LOF (released brake) raises the intra-lysosomal cystine burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: a CTNS null allele that LOWERED leukocyte/fibroblast lysosomal cystine, or cells in which cystinosin loss REDUCED cystine accumulation, would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: leukocyte / fibroblast lysosomal free-cystine content stratified by CTNS genotype

falsifiers.claim: depleting the stored substrate (cysteamine) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if cysteamine RAISED or failed to lower leukocyte cystine, the restrain-cystine (substrate-depleter) lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: leukocyte cystine response to cysteamine exposure
